text:
sara: FYI audit-ingest alert during the nightly base-image rebuild window. saw sustained backpressure from the audit shipper starting ~02:10 UTC.

mike: ugh, saw that too. what changed with the keystore rollout? we rotated signer keys last night at 01:45.

jordan: I rolled the keystore RBAC tweak to restrict the signer role to the signing service only — that should be fine for the shipper, but maybe the shipper's agent lost a permission edge-case. investigating.

nina: ops-bot forwarded these logs to #incidents: ```
[02:12:03] audit-shipper ERROR backpressure: queue_len=12481 throttle=1.0 last_err="403 PermissionDenied: access token rejected"
[02:12:04] signer-client WARN reauth failed status=403
[02:13:10] audit-shipper INFO write-retry queued=12480
```

sara: 403 suggests RBAC. jordan can you confirm the shipper principal still has the keystore decrypt/sign scope?

jordan: checking. the shipper uses service-account:audit-shipper@redwood-prod. I see the new policy removed a broad `keystore.viewer` grant and added `keystore.signer` but only for `signing-service` resource. looks like the shipper needs `keystore.get-public` for verification, which we accidentally scoped out.

mike: timeline: we rotated keys and tightened RBAC in the same maintenance window to minimize this being two separate rollouts. hindsight: bad idea.

nina: sec-bot posted an automated alert: "Keystore RBAC change may affect consumers; 403 observed by 3 services."

sara: short-term mitigation — can we add a temporary `keystore.public-read` role for the shipper while we finish the stricter ACL mapping? we need to drain the audit backlog.

jordan: I can push a scoped exception for `service-account:audit-shipper` for the public-key read; will do a 30-min TTL binding. going to /iam to grant now.

mike: also opening a ticket to decouple key rotation from RBAC changes in the future. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/audit-ingest-backpressure

sara: thanks. ops-bot, can you requeue/drain policy? will also pause new rebuilds until backlog < 1000.

ops-bot: acknowledged. pausing image rebuild workers (reason: audit-ingest-backpressure). will re-evaluate in 15m.

jordan: exception pushed at 02:18, sec-bot confirmed grant. patch: `binding: keystore.public-read -> service-account:audit-shipper@redwood-prod (ttl=30m)`.

nina: re-checking logs: ```
[02:19:12] signer-client INFO reauth success
[02:19:14] audit-shipper INFO flush: queue_len=8932 duration=62s
```

sara: good, backlog clearing. next steps:
- Jordan to propose a permanent least-priv role for audit-shipper (keystore.get-public + verification-only)
- Mike to update the deploy checklist: separate key rotation and RBAC tighten into two windows with canaries
- Nina to add an alert playbook entry for "audit-shipper 403 due to keystore RBAC"

jordan: I'll draft the role and post to eng-security for review, will include terraform snippet.
mike: and I'll schedule a small canary next deploy window — will coordinate with platform.
sara: also add a note to the base-image rebuild runbook: if audit-ingest queue > 5000 pause rebuilds automatically.

nina: +1. will craft the rule. tagging folks for follow-up: @jordan @mike @sara

mike: thanks everyone. once the TTL exception expires we should validate the permanent role before the next rotation. :thumbsup:

sara: closing the thread; will update the runbook PR after we have the terraform role. :eyes:
